label: CIG G-97CP GPON ONT
description: GPON ONT (Realtek RTL9601D, Linux Luna SDK 1.9.0) with a single 2.5GBase-T LAN port and no Wi-Fi; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on SC/APC, managed over SSH or serial. ODM reference for the platform also sold as the ZTE F6005 and Nokia G-010G-T.
